scope: Stand-alone universal asset-building engine; games are downstream clients, not development scope.

release_policy.paid_resource_retries: avoid unless they unblock measurable progress
release_policy.complete_when: Every required milestone has verified test artifacts, actual visual and downstream importer evidence, and user/artist approval. Do not infer completion from a green build.

status_definitions.verified: Measurable subset has passed actual CI; does not imply photorealism
status_definitions.partial: Useful tested foundation exists, but acceptance gate not met
status_definitions.planned: Acceptance gate untested or not implemented

milestones.name: Reproducible asset catalog and safe input schema
milestones.gate: pass 8-asset catalog reproducibility; reject invalid names/scales/seeds

milestones.name: Six reusable primitive/specialist builder families
milestones.gate: six categories produce original geometry, materials and glTF in isolated workers

milestones.name: glTF scene assembly with reusable instances
milestones.gate: compile 8 instances referencing 7 independently verified mesh sources

milestones.name: Indexed attribute-preserving mesh optimization
milestones.gate: deduplicate exact attributes per primitive; independently verify triangles, buffers, index bounds and bytes saved

milestones.name: Topology repair and semantic boundary classification
milestones.gate: closed human mesh 0 open boundary edges and 0 nonmanifold edges; intentionally open components classified

milestones.name: High resolution detailed geometry and non-destructive sculpt layers
milestones.gate: editable layer stack with headless DCC export; geometry validation on at least 3 asset families

milestones.name: Production UV unwrap and texture-space continuity
milestones.gate: verified UV seams, orientation, texel density and packing; checkerboard render across 3 assets

milestones.name: Layered PBR texture synthesis and baking
milestones.gate: albedo/normal/roughness/metallic/AO baker with testable UV alignment and headless PBR renders

milestones.name: Realistic skin, stone, wood, cloth and metal shader benchmarks
milestones.gate: reference-driven matched lighting turntables with manual material signoff

milestones.name: Automatic cinematic-to-mobile LOD chains
milestones.gate: LOD0 to LOD3 preserves salient silhouettes and UVs; measurable reduction with error thresholds

milestones.name: Interchangeable meshes, instancing and texture atlases
milestones.gate: shared geometry/material indexing validated at scale with runtime memory reporting

milestones.name: Retopologized five-digit hands, anatomical face and deformable body
milestones.gate: clean mesh and five digits verified at 14 angles plus poses; human artist signoff

milestones.name: Skin weights, skeletal animation, blend shapes, facial rigging
milestones.gate: rest-pose and 30+ joint stress tests; glTF skin/animation importer verification

milestones.name: Strand and cloth dynamics, collision-safe animation
milestones.gate: hair/cape sim in 5 dynamic movement tests without exploding or tearing

milestones.name: Creatures, monsters, clothing, armor and modular gear
milestones.gate: reproducible, editable original assets spanning each family with deformation tests

milestones.name: World biomes, modular interiors, roads, architecture, cave systems
milestones.gate: 3 coherent scene biomes and 2 modular interiors with nonintersecting placement checks

milestones.name: Props, tools, furniture, machinery, vehicles, weapons
milestones.gate: at least 20 parametric variants; collision metadata and functional assembly points

milestones.name: Water, vegetation, particles, VFX and decals
milestones.gate: deterministic authoring outputs and renderer-verified effects in 3 environments

milestones.name: 2D UI art, icons and decals; audio-source pipeline routing
milestones.gate: versioned sprites/UI packs and dedicated properly licensed audio pipeline, without claiming mesh generates sound

milestones.name: Image comparison and aesthetically meaningful render QA
milestones.gate: 14-angle actual asset images; reference scoring grounded in captured renders + manual approval

milestones.name: GPU/Android device tests and target platform budgets
milestones.gate: real-device or emulator import, screenshots, FPS/VRAM and memory measurements for 3 tiers

milestones.name: Secure versioned multi-platform asset pack publication
milestones.gate: signed checksums, import validation, rollback, never auto-promote unfinished assets

milestones.name: Bounded manager-worker CI development/review cycle
milestones.gate: 12 role-specific review assignments, isolated CI and no automatic game edits

milestones.name: High-quality scene showcase accepted by human
milestones.gate: artist-reviewed character, environment and game-ready demonstration with original reproducible source
